base_properties.human_readable: State Space Trap in Absorbing Markov Chain

perspectives.label: Trapped State
perspectives.comment: Once entered, the absorbing state is inescapable.

perspectives.label: System Designer
perspectives.comment: The system designer understands the properties of the absorbing Markov chain.

commentary.narrative_context: An absorbing Markov chain possesses one or more absorbing states. Once the chain enters an absorbing state, it is impossible to leave. This is a fundamental property of the mathematical structure.
commentary.logic_rationale: The chain's mathematical structure ensures that it remains in the absorbing state.
commentary.perspectival_gap: Both the trapped state and the system designer view this as a fundamental limitation.
